status: cause reproduced and repair verified by full 12-test suite
cause: On desk reopen, the retained diff renders immediately; the mode-dependent read effect then clears it and rereads the same pinned Git data. This destroys the first reopened editor and creates a second after the response, causing a missing-editor interval and needless initialization.
fix: A single successful diff read is paired with its refresh generation, pinned base/candidate revisions and file ID. Reopen reuses it; refresh/identity changes invalidate it. Mismatched reads never render.
fallback_finding: The captured read-only textboxes also exist in normal Monaco accessibility DOM. No separate application fallback branch or Monaco initialization exception was found in the diagnostic run. DiffEditor.tsx and accessibility/read-only options are unchanged.
